**4B.2 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador (2024)**

**Bottom line:** mixed, leaning negative. AMLO publicly accepted the 2024 transfer of power, but the stronger 2024 record is that he pushed institutional changes and court/electoral reforms critics said would entrench Morena’s advantage and weaken independent constraints.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Presentan resultados de elecciones en conferencia del presidente; se requiere garantizar el derecho a la información, afirma | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-05 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presentan-resultados-de-elecciones-en-conferencia-del-presidente-se-requiere-garantizar-el-derecho-a-la-informacion-afirma/ | AMLO publicly presented the presidential results and framed the moment around public access to information, which is limited positive evidence that he accepted the election outcome rather than trying to void it. | 4B.2, 4B.1 |
| 20.06.24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-20 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/20-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/ | AMLO said a vote-by-vote recount is the best way to remove suspicion and that one should respect what the electoral authority decides. This is a narrow pro-process signal, but it does not outweigh later institutional-manipulation evidence. | 4B.2, 4B.1 |
| Tribunal Electoral valida elección presidencial: Segob; presidente celebra ejemplar transición en gobierno federal | Presidencia de México | 2024-08-13 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/tribunal-electoral-valida-eleccion-presidencial-segob-presidente-celebra-ejemplar-transicion-en-gobierno-federal/ | After the electoral tribunal validated the presidential election, AMLO’s government publicly celebrated an “ejemplar transición.” That is direct evidence of procedural acceptance of the handoff. | 4B.2, 4B.1 |
| Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with super-majority in sight | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-04 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906 | Reuters reported that AMLO frequently lambasted the INE and pushed an overhaul that critics said could cement Morena’s political hegemony and lower the bar for referendums. This is strong negative evidence on manipulating electoral rules and commissions to entrench power. | 4B.2 |
| Mexico's sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-15 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588 | Reuters reported AMLO’s judicial overhaul was formally enacted amid criticism that it weakened judicial independence. Because courts are part of the anti-entrenchment constraint set, this is negative evidence that he did not refrain from rule-changing to preserve control. | 4B.2, 4B.4 |
| Mexico proposed constitutional changes threaten rights | Human Rights Watch | 2024-08-30 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights | HRW warned AMLO’s proposed constitutional changes could weaken judicial independence, expand military power, and erode privacy/transparency safeguards. This is broad negative evidence that the administration was widening coercive and institutional leverage rather than self-constraining. | 4B.2, 4B.4, 4B.8 |
| Mexico final year overview | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico | The Reuters Institute described AMLO’s final year as marked by continued verbal attacks on journalists and the media. This is weaker but relevant negative evidence for media pressure and a hostile environment around scrutiny. | 4B.2, 3B.3, 3B.8 |

**Search gap:** I found strong 2024 evidence on electoral-rule and court manipulation, but much thinner direct evidence on misuse of public resources for entrenchment. The public-resource side is better treated as an evidentiary gap than as a proven clean record.
